JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 1 · Launch

You lie in the Commander's couch, on top of a Saturn V at Launch Complex 39A. Until the escape tower is jettisoned three minutes after liftoff, a protective cover hides the windows except a small one over the hatch window. Sit down in a chair before you start.

Mission briefing first (optional): twelve narrated schematics of every stage. Next: chapter 2, to the Moon (in the headset, A at the end of this chapter takes you there).

Boarding: stand up. The left stick walks, the right stick turns; walk into the White Room to the open hatch to climb in (or pull the trigger there). Then sit down in a chair.

Not authentic, for curiosity: Y opens a big window in the wall to your left; hold B to step outside and look at the spacecraft (left stick: round it and nearer or further, right stick: up and down). Your gloved hands follow the controllers; the controls are not yours to touch yet.

In the couch: you are seated where your head is; press a thumbstick to re-seat yourself if you move. A or X runs time faster (×4, ×16) once the windows are clear, B or Y hides the frame-rate panel on your left hand. The controllers vibrate with the rocket; the view itself never shakes.

On this screen: drag to look, WASD walk while boarding, E climb in, Space start or pause, W faster (in the couch), C window, O outside (JL round, IK up/down, UM nearer/further), 1–5 jump (count, ignition, tower, staging, orbit).

Voices are synthetic for now. Earth: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation; the clouds are generated. All chapters
